# Model-route and candidate reconciliation

## Current update — 1 October 2026

**Disposition:** retain `openrouter/stealth/space-bunny-alpha` as the selected, released free route. The corrected frozen screen passed its bounded scientific/reliability criteria in 200 responses at reported $0; the deployed public flow completed 71/71 tasks with 178 observed/priced responses at reported $0 and unchanged account usage. The 29 recovered API-error attempts and citation limitations remain visible. These results do not establish intrinsic model quality, expert validation, or general reliability.

Ling Sante's rejection applies only to the pinned Novita/model/request configuration: two completed primary judgments missed the frozen `partial` label; trial 3's separate verifier remains incomplete. Other configurations are unassessed. Cloudflare's larger-output variant remains untested, unqualified, and deliberately unselected, not rejected: only the frozen 1,024-output-token configuration is known to have truncated at the closing turn. The owner’s retention waiver does not prove unattended free-plan admission, tool completion, or scientific quality, and the larger-output variant remains untested and unqualified. Its untested status is not rejection evidence; the campaign contract allows this unselected model alternative to remain unqualified without blocking the selected-model release. Qwen's operational disposition and the tested Ling Fin/Groq dispositions remain limited to their recorded endpoints/configurations.

`M11-NOV-01` is **rejected for the exact preregistered study9 adaptation**. The [terminal receipt](../../sakana/novelty-pilot-v9-terminal-2026-10-01.json) records 24 normally stopped model responses and 36 MCP calls, with no retries, fallback or response-cache hits, reported $0 and unchanged account usage. All 72 blinded labels were finalized before unblinding. Its raw runner status `PILOT_COMPLETE_LABELS_PENDING` precedes scoring; the final scientific status is `COMPLETE_SCIENTIFIC_FAIL_REJECT_EXACT_CONFIGURATION`.

The [assessment](../../sakana/novelty-pilot-v9-scientific-assessment-2026-10-01.json) records positive-target coverage of 3/6 in both arms, with one gain and one loss, and control-anchor coverage of 4/6 static versus 3/6 candidate, with two losses. These fail the frozen criteria of at least one additional positive target without any positive loss, and no control-anchor loss. Independent arithmetic review accepted all 12 rows and 72 label joins. No confirmation or adoption follows. This rejects the tested adaptation; exposed development inputs do not establish a fresh-holdout or general technique/model result. Studies1–8 remain incomplete, unscored and immutable.

M12-04b4 and b5 are completed at `86e90502` and `c9837997`. Candidate reconciliation now has a tested-configuration rejection for Ling Sante, an unselected/unqualified Cloudflare alternative, and an evidence-backed rejection of the remaining repository adaptation. Cloudflare's untested performance is not represented as resolved; the contract permits unselected model alternatives to remain unqualified. Final campaign acceptance and release integration remain M12-04b8. This documentation update made no provider call.

## Historical snapshot — 30 September 2026

**Disposition:** retain `openrouter/stealth/space-bunny-alpha` as the selected, released free route. Its exact configuration passed the frozen scientific/reliability screen and completed a deployed public flow. This qualifies those bounded interfaces and inputs; it does not establish intrinsic model quality, expert validation, or general reliability. No provider calls or new qualification probes were made for this reconciliation.

| Candidate | Current disposition and evidence |
|---|---|
| Qwen / ModelRun | **Campaign-route reliability disqualification only.** Repeated upstream shared-pool 429s produced no served-model evidence; do not retry this endpoint. This says nothing about intrinsic scientific quality. [Capability evidence](qwen-m11-capabilities-2026-09-26.json), [disposition receipt](../../m11-qwen-disposition-release-2026-09-26.json). |
| Ling Fin / Novita | **Reject this frozen configuration.** Three completed trials repeated the same `insufficient` versus gold `partial` error. [Assessment](ling-fin-batch-assessment-v1.md). |
| Groq Free | **Reject the tested scientific configurations under their frozen gates.** The Qwen 3.8 screen completed but failed exact-source citation provenance; the separate GPT-OSS 20B screen missed the partial label and cited another claim’s contradiction passage. Interface success does not override these completed failures. [Qwen 3.8 assessment](groq-qwen38-scientific-assessment-2026-09-27.md), [GPT-OSS assessment](groq20-scientific-assessment-2026-09-26.md). |
| Ling Sante / Novita | **Reject the pinned configuration under its existing repeated-completed-failure rule.** Two completed primary judgments missed `partial`; trial 3’s separate verifier remains incomplete and does not erase those judgments. Other configurations are unassessed. [30 September disposition](ling-sante-disposition-2026-09-30.md). |
| Cloudflare larger-output variant | **The frozen 1,024-output configuration failed tool completion; the larger-output variant remains untested/unqualified and is deliberately unselected, not rejected.** It is an unadopted alternative, not an accepted product improvement or release blocker. The owner’s retention waiver removes that gate; unattended free-plan admission, completed tool behavior, and scientific quality remain unproven. The [campaign contract](../../../../PLAN.md) allows unselected alternatives to remain unqualified. [Frozen trial record](cloudflare-workers-free-candidate-2026-09-26.md). |

The selected route’s frozen screen passed three four-claim trials and three citation panels: 200 responses identified the same model, reported $0, and had no transport error or deterministic fallback; account usage was unchanged. Its [deployed public flow](../../m12-free-default-public-acceptance-2026-09-30.json) completed 71/71 tasks with 178 observed/priced responses at reported $0 and unchanged account usage. Limits remain explicit: 29 recovered API-error attempts, 21 unsupported and 4 unavailable citations, and no expert or wet-lab validation. The [Robin continuation](../../m12-robin-continuation-acceptance-2026-09-30.json) separately traversed all 17 new tasks and the ordinary workflow gates with 30 observed/priced responses at reported $0; deep verification weakened the child and one unsupported categorical claim triggered a recorded claim-gate block. These receipts establish operational integration, not experimental validity. See the [corrected frozen-screen result](../../m12-space-bunny-corrected-result-2026-09-30.md).

`M11-NOV-01` remains **promising and unresolved**. The [v1 interruption](../../sakana/novelty-pilot-interruption-2026-09-30.json) exposed missing trace instrumentation; the corrected [v2 study](../../sakana/novelty-pilot-v2-interruption-2026-09-30.json) stopped on PubMed HTTP 502. The independently registered [v3 study](../../sakana/novelty-pilot-v3-interruption-2026-09-30.json) stopped on an upstream metadata-fetch error, identified as HTTP 429 in its retained MCP log. Its source-pin repair and all 42 offline cases were verified before admission and are [released in PR #80](../../m12-reference-evidence-release-2026-09-30.json). The offline runner/pin work is complete; it is no longer the next prerequisite. All three one-shot admissions are consumed and none produced a complete paired scientific comparison. No replay, retrospective scoring, scientific rejection or adoption follows from those interruptions. Therefore **M12-04b7 remains unchecked**: model alternatives have bounded dispositions, but novelty reconciliation requires evidence not supplied by these incomplete studies. The [30 September current update](../../m11-follow-up-register.md) and [Sakana dossier](../../sakana-ai-scientist.md) retain the current scientific boundary; older assessments remain historical evidence.
